name: What is the process of filing a workplace discrimination complaint?

mainEntity.name: What is the process of filing a workplace discrimination complaint?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical process for filing a workplace discrimination complaint often starts with an internal company complaint, if applicable. If unresolved, you generally need to file a charge of discrimination with a government agency such as the California Department of Fair Employment and Housing (DFEH) or the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) within specific deadlines. These agencies investigate the claim or issue a "right-to-sue" letter, which allows you to file a lawsuit in court. A lawyer can guide you through each step and ensure all deadlines are met.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves filing an internal complaint, then a charge with an agency like DFEH or EEOC. These agencies investigate or issue a right-to-sue letter, allowing you to file a lawsuit.
